name: Fan motors
description: Indoor and outdoor unit motor replacements.
long_description: Indoor blower motors move air across the cooling coil, and outdoor fan motors carry heat away from the condenser. A weak or noisy motor reduces cooling and strains the compressor. We supply motors matched by shaft size, rotation, RPM and mounting.
match_by: Shaft size, rotation, RPM and mounting

parts.name: Indoor blower motors
parts.detail: Cross-flow blower motors for wall-mounted indoor units.
parts.summary: The indoor blower motor turns the cross-flow blower wheel that moves air through the indoor coil. We supply AC (PSC) and DC (BLDC) motors matched to your unit's model, shaft and mounting.
specs: Single-phase PSC with capacitor, or brushless DC (BLDC)
220–240 V, 50 Hz (PSC); DC bus from the indoor PCB (BLDC)
Rubber end-mounts or cradle, per unit model
Hall sensor or speed signal on many models
notes: Share the motor code from its label: wiring and connectors differ by brand
A slow or noisy blower can also be a dirty wheel or failed capacitor

parts.name: Outdoor condenser fan motors
parts.detail: Motors that carry heat away from the outdoor coil.
parts.summary: Condenser fan motors drive the outdoor fan that moves air through the condenser coil. A failed or slow fan quickly causes high pressure and tripping.
specs: Single-phase PSC with capacitor, three-phase, or BLDC
About 30–80 W for split ACs; up to 250 W and above for larger units
220–240 V, 1-phase, 50 Hz; 380–415 V, 3-phase on larger units
Bracket or through-bolt, per unit model
notes: Match output, speed, rotation direction, shaft size and mounting

parts.name: BLDC / DC inverter fan motors
parts.summary: Inverter ACs use brushless DC fan motors with built-in drive electronics. The PCB sets the speed with a control signal, giving quiet, efficient variable-speed airflow.
specs: High-voltage DC bus, typically about 280–340 V DC
Vsp voltage signal from the PCB
FG speed pulse back to the PCB
5-pin plug on most models (pin-out varies by brand)
notes: Pin-outs differ between brands: match the motor code, not just the size
A fan fault code can also come from the PCB's drive circuit

parts.name: Fan blades & blower wheels
parts.summary: Outdoor units use axial propeller fan blades; indoor units use long cross-flow blower wheels. Cracked or unbalanced fans cause noise, vibration and poor airflow.
specs: Axial, usually 3 blades; sized by diameter
Cross-flow; sized by length and diameter
AS / ABS or glass-fibre reinforced plastic
Matched to the motor shaft (commonly 8 mm), with D-flat or set screw
notes: Share diameter, length, bore and the unit model, or a photo of the old part

signs: Weak airflow from the indoor unit
Outdoor fan not spinning while the AC runs
